listing_card.description: Welcome to the Sakina Foundation Trust. For over a decade, we've fought poverty, hunger, and illiteracy. Mohammed Asif Hussain Sohail has been using his expenses to feed thousands of the impoverished, needy, and disadvantaged every day for more than ten years. They used to just serve a few hundred when they first started ten years ago. However, as the number of those in need increased, the Sakina Foundation hired cooks to assist them, and thousands of impoverished and needy people now receive their one meal from them. Fill A School Bag Challenge District Hyderabad State Telangana District Hyderabad States Telangana Sakina Foundation Trust hopes to spread awareness of the Challenge through this campaign, inviting people from all walks of life to donate supplies such as school bags, notebooks, pencils, pens, slates, chalk, compass boxes, and regular textbooks to the impoverished and needy children attending government and foundation-adopted schools. Through this project, we wish to assist impoverished children throughout our nation and encourage a wide number of individuals to support this new idea of empowering and assisting the needy.
